comment: Named-baseline registry for the pi-v1.3.0 audit evidence families (#1046, ADR 0075).
A baseline name resolves to exactly one full 40-character revision. Ticket families are
registered under that baseline by name; each record pins its manifest SHA-256.
Use scripts/evidence/audit_evidence.py to check, register, verify and read. There is no
free-form revision input: an ad-hoc revision lets an operator verify one family against
another baseline's checkout while every individual check still passes.
Audit lanes own their audit-<ticket> bundle directory; only the serial merger edits this
registry through the register command. Historical pi-ai/pi-tui registries are separate.
